# Know where your visitors come from. Keep the data.

> Free, self-hosted, cookie-free web analytics: visitors, sources, UTM campaigns and goals with revenue by source. An open-source alternative to Plausible, Fathom and Simple Analytics. MIT, zero dependencies.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
